Manhattan Active WM cost

Manhattan Active WM is the tier-1 cloud-native warehouse management system. Quote-only. Third-party guidance puts subscription at $20K-$60K/month and implementation at $1M-$5M+. We do not invent a midpoint.

[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Quote-only enterprise SaaS; cost-to-serve based on warehouse volume, modules, users[s-01].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Warehouse count and sqft per DC.
  • Module selection: WMS + Labor + Slotting + Yard + Order Streaming all priced separately.
  • Named users and concurrent peak users.
  • Manhattan Active Maven (AI orchestration) bundled in 2025-26, no published list price.
  • Implementation complexity: omnichannel store fulfillment doubles the SI hours.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Continued migration of legacy WMOS / SCALE customers to the Active WM cloud-native suite. AI orchestration (Manhattan Active Maven) bundled into the platform in 2025-26 with no published list price.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Tier-1 omnichannel retailer running >5 DCs and >1M sqft of footprint.
  • 3PL with multi-tenant, multi-client billing on a cloud-native rewrite.
  • Existing Manhattan WMOS / SCALE customer migrating to Active WM.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

What is the realistic price range?

Public reference deals on G2 and Gartner place Manhattan Active WM subscription at $20K-$60K/mo and implementation at $1M-$5M+ for tier-1 deployments. The quote is built per DC, per module, per named user.

Why is Manhattan quote-only?

Because the cost-to-serve math depends on warehouse volume, module count, and named users. A list price would underprice tier-1 retailers and overprice 3PL deployments.

When is Manhattan the wrong fit?

Single-DC SMB with <50 users. The implementation overhead alone destroys the ROI. Use Fishbowl, Logiwa, or ShipHero instead.
